   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from sklearn.datasets import load_iris\n",
    "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder\n",
    "from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential\n",
    "from tensorflow.keras.layers import Dense\n",
    "\n",
    "iris = load_iris()\n",
    "X = iris.data\n",
    "y = iris.target.reshape(-1, 1)\n",
    "classes = iris.target_names\n",
    "\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    encoder = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False)\n",
    "except TypeError:\n",
    "    encoder = OneHotEncoder(sparse=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_encoded = encoder.fit_transform(y)\n",
    "\n",
    "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
    "X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)\n",
    "\n",
    "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
    "    X_scaled, y_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "def create_mlp(input_dim, output_dim, hidden_layers, activation='relu'):\n",
    "    model = Sequential()\n",
    "    model.add(Dense(hidden_layers[0], input_dim=input_dim, activation=activation))\n",
    "    for units in hidden_layers[1:]:\n",
    "        model.add(Dense(units, activation=activation))\n",
    "    model.add(Dense(output_dim, activation='softmax'))\n",
    "    model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='categorical_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])\n",
    "    return model\n",
    "\n",
    "hidden_layer_configs = [[8], [16, 8], [32, 16, 8]]\n",
    "activations = ['relu', 'tanh', 'sigmoid']\n",
    "\n",
    "best_model = None\n",
    "best_acc = -1.0\n",
    "best_config = None\n",
    "\n",
    "for hidden_layers in hidden_layer_configs:\n",
    "    for activation in activations:\n",
    "        print(f\"\\nTesting MLP with hidden_layers={hidden_layers}, activation={activation}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = create_mlp(\n",
    "            input_dim=4, output_dim=3,\n",
    "            hidden_layers=hidden_layers, activation=activation\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        history = model.fit(\n",
    "            X_train, y_train, epochs=50, batch_size=5,\n",
    "            verbose=0, validation_split=0.1\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        test_loss, test_acc = model.evaluate(X_test, y_test, verbose=0)\n",
    "        print(f\"Test Accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}, Test Loss: {test_loss:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "        plt.suptitle(f\"Config: {hidden_layers}, Activation: {activation}\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)\n",
    "        plt.plot(history.history['accuracy'], label='Train Acc')\n",
    "        plt.plot(history.history['val_accuracy'], label='Val Acc')\n",
    "        plt.xlabel('Epoch')\n",
    "        plt.ylabel('Accuracy')\n",
    "        plt.title('Model Accuracy')\n",
    "        plt.legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)\n",
    "        plt.plot(history.history['loss'], label='Train Loss')\n",
    "        plt.plot(history.history['val_loss'], label='Val Loss')\n",
    "        plt.xlabel('Epoch')\n",
    "        plt.ylabel('Loss')\n",
    "        plt.title('Model Loss')\n",
    "        plt.legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "        plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "        if test_acc > best_acc:\n",
    "            best_acc = test_acc\n",
    "            best_model = model\n",
    "            best_config = (hidden_layers, activation)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nBest config: hidden_layers={best_config[0]}, activation={best_config[1]}, \"\n",
    "      f\"Test Accuracy={best_acc:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "sepal_length = float(input(\"Sepal length (cm): \"))\n",
    "sepal_width = float(input(\"Sepal width (cm): \"))\n",
    "petal_length = float(input(\"Petal length (cm): \"))\n",
    "petal_width = float(input(\"Petal width (cm): \"))\n",
    "\n",
    "user_input = np.array([[sepal_length, sepal_width, petal_length, petal_width]])\n",
    "user_input_scaled = scaler.transform(user_input)\n",
    "prediction = best_model.predict(user_input_scaled)\n",
    "predicted_class_index = np.argmax(prediction)\n",
    "predicted_class_name = classes[predicted_class_index]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nPredicted Iris Species: {predicted_class_name}\")"
   ]
  }
